apiHost.description: The LaunchDarkly host address. If this argument is not specified, the default host address is `https://app.launchdarkly.com`

archiveFlagsOnDestroy.description: When `true`, removing a `launchdarkly.FeatureFlag` resource from your Terraform configuration archives the flag in LaunchDarkly instead of deleting it. The flag's key is retained on the server, so re-applying a configuration that recreates the same flag key will fail with an error directing you to `terraform import` the archived flag. Defaults to `false`, which preserves the existing destroy-deletes behavior. This setting affects only `launchdarkly.FeatureFlag`. Other resources continue to be deleted on destroy.

httpTimeout.description: The HTTP timeout (in seconds) when making API calls to LaunchDarkly. Defaults to 20 seconds.

maxConcurrency.description: The maximum number of concurrent API requests the provider makes to LaunchDarkly. Defaults to `1`. Increase this value to speed up plan and refresh operations on large configurations. Higher values make it more likely that requests exceed your account's API rate limit. If a request exceeds the rate limit, LaunchDarkly returns a `429` response and the provider retries the request automatically.

oauthToken.description: An OAuth V2 token you use to authenticate with LaunchDarkly. You can also set this with the `LAUNCHDARKLY_OAUTH_TOKEN` environment variable. You must provide either `accessToken` or `oauthToken`.
